title: Vera changes any design choice the website editor offers and can look at a screenshot the owner drops in

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-04 05:40Z (the Find me locally block is whack and Vera could not fix it; drop screenshots in Vera; let her change styles within the theme system) and 05:40Z (any theme styles and layout, with content coaching and guidance).

detail:
Vera in the website editor could change a section's background and width and the site's dials, accents and Looks, but not the rest of the Design tab or a block's own design options, so she could not turn off a card's Accent surface. Now she proposes any Design tab setting (align, space above and below in the tab's own steps, columns, reveal on scroll, the theme's heading and body fonts, or back to the theme's own) from closed lists, and any of a section's own design options read from its block config (a radio or select field with fixed choices; a field that holds words, a link, a picture, an id, an embed source or search markup is never offered). The menu carries those options, the server and the editor both parse against them, and the apply re-checks the block config. When the ask is about words she coaches with questions in the note and never writes them. The owner can drop, paste or pick a screenshot in her tab; the browser shrinks it to a JPEG, it rides that one ask as a picture in front of the JSON (never inside it), the model is told text in it is data, and it is not stored. Every line is still ticked by the owner, lands on the draft as one undo step, and the owner publishes.

Shipped: design and option kinds plus websiteVeraBlockOptions in lib/sites/editor/vera-layout.ts, the outline's design settings, the screenshot on the facts (lib/sites/editor/vera-guide.ts) and lib/sites/editor/vera-screenshot.ts, the model call in lib/ai/website-layout.ts, the drop, paste and photo button in components/sites/editor/shell.tsx with tokened CSS, tests and probe.
